concept.title: A school that can support a child with additional needs
concept.shortdesc: As a parent of a child recently assessed with dyspraxia, I need to compare schools by how well they support additional needs, so that I can choose the right school for her.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-009). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: parents of children with special educational needs.
Situation: Considering moving a child to a better-equipped school.
A good result: The local SEND offer and a way to compare schools on support, with the route to an education health and care plan assessment if needed.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.
